flashcard_questions.q: The way different musical lines or parts are layered together in a piece of music.
A texture consisting of a single melodic line with no accompaniment.
When two or more performers play or sing the same notes at the same pitch at the same time.

flashcard_questions.a: A texture where one main melody is supported by an accompaniment of chords or other parts.
A texture where two or more independent melodic lines are heard at the same time.
